strings.en: Looks like you stepped in too far.
All that's left is to deliver results.
That move... was a fatal one.
I'll clear out the conspicuous targets first.
This one's mine, I daresay-ish, darling.
Evasion is quite impossible, as it were-ly.
That was, like, totally a nice range-y thing.
I shall partake, darling... No, that won't do.
Here I go-ey, please... Ahem. Here I come...!
Not a bad distance, if I may humbly say...!
Just like the simulation, so it is-ish, dear.
You're too far forward, if I may say, darling.
You stepped in too far-ish and stuff-ity.../　Damn, it's getting even worse.
You think you can escape my sights, huh.../　Hm? What language mode is this?
Right there, if you please!/　...Speech quirks aside, this is...
I'mma mess ya up good, ya hear!/　...Even a language mode like this...
Ufufu, pun-ish-ment time~!/　...This won't do either.
Y'all just leave it to me now!/　...A proto-code?
From this angle, you can't evade in time...
Distance, speed rechecked. Here I go...!
My line of fire won't stray...!
Swallowed by your own obsession, Jua-Mu?
You'll face me as well, Al-Van.
Don't think things will go your way, Karo-Ran.
Those who opened the gate to another world/　will pay the price...!
Gu-Landon, you will never take the throne...!
So that Raig-Geios is the commander unit.
Whatever his words, his movements are precise.
If that man truly heads the Golaikunru,/　I doubt he'd show up in a place like this.
The Cross Gate/　will bring disaster upon you too.
Whose taste that look is, I don't know, but...
So you'll meddle in this world too...!
Targeting only the Kaana type, then.
Your illusions won't work on me.
An opponent I'd have to eliminate either way.
No life signs inside. Destroying it.
Eliminating it along with the Yokijin.
So remnants of the Dark Brain remained.
You're nothing but a broken machine, after all...!
You should never have come to this world...!
A door to another world.../　is a source of calamity!
Don't tell me you don't know/　the Privy Council's decision.
I'd heard you weren't to interfere in the Earth Sphere.
We have complete data on you.
They just don't know when to give up.
I'd shoot you down even if you weren't Golaikunru.
Crush the head and disorder follows. Standard theory.
I know exactly how to defeat the Zeranio class.
Is it premature to judge them Zovorg?
Collecting data on the new model.
Big Shoulder confirmed. Shooting it down.
Breaking one corner of the encirclement!
If it's a new model, I'll collect data.
Annihilating the unknowns is top priority now.
Beginning data collection on the unknowns...
That giant Lamaris can't be allowed out of here.
Concentrating fire on the Ida type.
Ares Geist.../　What did you seek in returning to this side?
I'll go along with Arieil's gamble too.
Drawing the Ares Geist away from the Cross Gate.
Let your looks be the only joke here.
I'll put that earlier data to use.
This time, I'm on the offense...!
Striking first was careless of you.
A return gift, if you please, yes.../　No... that won't do.
Now is my turn, if you please, yes...!
I thought it'd last longer... Misjudged.
I cannot be making excuses, can I, yes...
Ngh...! I relied too much on the data!
Have they found this unit's limits...?!
Cutting control to damaged areas.../　That'll have to hold.
Halting power to damaged sections.../　Purging damaged armor.
It seems I've found some pride of my own...!
That's sorta beyond the data-ish, yes.../　Hm, that won't do.
A misjudgment on my part, it is being.../　Ngh... A misjudgment indeed...
So this is what backs up his confidence...!
Not a direct hit... but/　a good sign nonetheless.
You can't take me down yet.
They took some of my armor...!
Over the predicted damage? Not good...
My, you are being quite skillful, yes...!/　...And I've slipped up again.
You cannot be downing me yet, my dear.../　No... I won't go down yet.
The Type-Haken's armor can still hold out.
So you do have some pride, Jua-Mu.
I have to stop the Zee-Gadin here...!
Better performance than the Gyanonia Ogre...!
I must find an opening in the Floraga...!
If it's disposable, it can make suicide attacks...!
I don't intend to play along with his tricks, but...!
I can't let the Crystal Dragoon/　overpower me here.
As expected, he's the strongest of the legion...!
XN-L, I won't let you go any further...!
It seems to have been improved somewhat.
...I'll need to reassess the commander unit's data.
I must hold back the Fury here...!
The Raftclans' movements/　can't be fully read from data alone...!
I didn't think I'd underestimated/　the Raftclans' performance, but...
To be held up by the Lamaris...
Things aren't the same as before...!
Minor damage... no effect on combat.
No need to dodge something this weak...
So we're feeling each other out...
Only a graze, it was being, yes.
Predicting your next action pattern/　and whatnot, yes... Ngh, I'm glitching...
Is that meant to keep me in check, Al-Van Ranks?
Fu-Ruu... Did you read my evasion pattern?
An Emperor Unit in name only, it seems.
So that woman is the final barrier.
Is that the best you can do, Crystal Dragoon?
I couldn't shake off the Skull Knight.
Minor damage. Continuing to draw the enemy in.
Lamaris Kaana... I've taken your data.
The Ares Geist's power/　shouldn't be this weak...
Ares Geist... So it's taken the bait.
It's because it follows theory that it doesn't work.
Where is it you are looking, if you please?
You can't shoot down this Angelg.
Dancing like the wind... That is Vaisaga.
The Ashsaviour's mobility/　is beyond your imagination.
This Razangriff.../　isn't as sluggish as it looks.
I can't afford to break this Type-Haken.
Are you dragging out the fight on purpose?
Jua-Mu, you can't lay a finger on me.
Perhaps I overrated the title of Chief Agent.
Is that all the Zee-Gadin can do?
Iradoya, I won't fall for your tricks.
Reggiane, I won't be your prey.
Trying to use the Cross Gate's energy...!
You won't hit me, Crystal Dragoon.
Skull Knight, are your eyes just for show?
I have no business with Zovorg small fry.
No matter how many times/　you come to the Earth Sphere...!
I've already analyzed the commander unit's specs.
It grew bigger, so it slowed down.
The Ida's attacks don't seem very accurate.
Its speed isn't much different than before.
I can't afford to let that hit.
How very unfortunate-ness... I mean, too bad.
Commander unit or not, that skill won't cut it.
Evasion successful. Continuing to draw the enemy in.
This one uses a lot of feints.
Managed to avoid a direct hit.
An attack like that won't reach me!
Out of range...? It can't be helped...
Don't be shy. Take this too.
Supportings I shall be providing.../　I mean, moving in to support...
I'm not not unwilling to support... I will.
Leave the rest to me, y'hear!/　...Seriously, what is this?
With the Lieutenant and me together...!
Lieutenant, leave-ish it to me-ness.../　I mean, leave it to me.
Sister Excellen, leave the rest to me.
Sister Excellen.../　You're leaving the rest to me?
Sister Excellen, supporting is what I do.
Major, leave the rest to me.
Major Kai, supporting you I shall be-ness.
Arado, where do you think you're going?
Latune, leave that enemy to me.
Major Gilliam, I'll handle that enemy.
Captain Axel, I'll back you up.
Captain.../　He may not look it, but he factored/　in my movements too.
Captain, leave the rest to yours truly.../　Er, to me.
Heh.../　Teamwork like this was once unthinkable.
Her timing is easy to match...!
So she factored my movements in as well.
Leave the rest to me, Lieutenant Hugo.
Rim, leave the rest to yours truly.../　Er, to me.
Kusuha, leave the rest to me.
Don't get too worked up, Kota.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Here to lend a hand, Sister Aschen, I am.
It seems you didn't notice me.
Outta the wa-a-ay! No, wait, that's not it!
I'll protect my master!/　...Master, you say?
Sis Exce, withdraw while you can.
Sis Exce, please do be steppin' back.
Lieutenant, fall back while you can.
Major,/　that was dangerous-ish or somethin' maybe!
Captain Axel,/　that was most careless-ish, it is.
I won't let them take the captain...!
You should fall back here, Josh.
Kota, don't get too far ahead.
This may be unwanted help for Sister Aschen, but...!
Your formation... I'll use it against you!
I'm gonna Attack Again-ish, so I am.
Phantom Phoenix shall blast you/　sky-high-ness, if you please!!
At this range... I won't miss!
Cleave the earth, race through the sky!!
The Five Great Swords can/　be used like this, too!
Can you see through this attack...!?
No one can block the blade of wind!
Surpass the wind... and then the light!
Five Great Swords, like a flash of light!!
Slicey-dicey with the Five Great Swords!
This will finish you for sure...!
It's not just the armor/　that's been upgraded...!
Once I have you in my grip...
All that's left is to crush you!
Don't think you can escape this speed!
Distance calculated. Error corrected,/　transferring data...
To take them all out, I should use this.
I won't lose a contest of power...!
This weapon has no blind spot...!
This is what you get for bunching up.
Take an avalanche of steel spheres!
Bunker!/　You can't take this Continuous Attack!!
Behold the power of a Super Fighter.
Let me show you/　what makes a Super Fighter.
The stars weren't aligned in your favor.
The Type-3 has attack patterns/　like this, too!
Vanish into the depths of misfortune...!
By the time you notice.../　you've been shot through!
Watch closely. You'll do this someday too.
Going in with a Continuous Attack!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Alright, we're practicing this when we get back~!
Vanish in the blink of an evil star.
Another star in the sky, then.
Don't think you can read it!
I'll stop you in your tracks!
